question.text: Within how many working days from the closure of the tendering period must payment be made to shareholders who tendered their shares in an open offer?

explanation.text: The Logic: Under SAST Regulations, the acquirer must complete the open-offer requirements, including payment to the shareholders who tendered their shares, within 10 working days from the last date / expiry of the tendering period. The Trap: "15 working days" is the timeline within which SEBI gives its comments on the draft letter of offer after receipt, not the payment timeline. "5 working days" is the timeline within which the draft letter of offer is filed with SEBI from the date of the detailed public statement. Candidates often mix up these various SAST timelines. Note: NISM Series IX Merchant Banking workbook supports the 10-working-day payment timeline (pages 213, 215) and the separate 5-working-day draft-letter filing and 15-working-day SEBI comment timelines (page 208).
